summary: Galgame generator for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): give it a script document plus character/background/BGM assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with 9-slot save/load, speaker-following sprites, BGM control and if-line branching. DSH Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档 + 立绘/背景/音乐素材即可生成可玩视觉小说（9 槽位存档、自动立绘、BGM、if 条件线）。

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a media-generation utility for DSH: it scans provided script and multimedia assets, builds a playable visual-novel HTML experience, and wires it into the DSH web interface for playback. Core capabilities include branching/script parsing, save states, sprite/background/BGM control, and standalone output generation. No external-service/network control is evident; risk is moderate due generated local HTML/media handling in the browser context (R1).
